draft.emotion: furrowed brow and quiet voice, carrying a worry that won't go away
notes: Takes the instrumental case for the cause of worry (обеспокоенный чем-либо) or the preposition за + accusative for the person worried about.
As a predicate ('is/was worried'), the short forms обеспокоен, обеспокоена, обеспокоены are normally used.
